verdict.rationale: Warp documents custom scheduled or event-triggered jobs, and its agent "records every action it takes." An action log is an audit trail, which is adjacent to this story but is not versioning, review, or rollback of the automations themselves. Nothing in the pack shows automation version history, change review, or reverting to a prior version, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
